scope: vendor/qcom/opensource/display-drivers msm_drm for canoe on android18-7.3 (sources/defines from display_modules.bzl + targets/canoe.bzl)
reviewed_changes: avr-drm-compat.h: drm_atomic_state->drm_atomic_commit renames; <drm/drm_print.h>; clk round_rate->determine_rate wrappers (6.12 core semantics); bridge non-atomic hooks->atomic wrappers + attach(encoder); strncpy (removed from 7.x, exact semantics); devm_gpio_request (gpio_request+devres free); drm_atomic_get_existing_{plane,crtc}_state = state_to_destroy (6.12 .state); drm_wait_one_vblank (6.12: 100 ms); drm_panel_init (6.12 init + one permanent ref, no container)

avr-canoe-vendor-config.h (scripts/gen_drm_vendor_config.py): canoe_perf.bzl y/m options referenced by msm_drm or any header it includes but absent from the 7.3 .config (e.g. QCOM_LLCC, QCOM_RPMH, FSA4480, WCD_USBSS, GH_IRQ_LEND, DWC3_MSM, ALTMODE): without them llcc/rpmh resolve to 7.3 inline stubs. Result: module dependency set identical to the phone msm_drm
avr-llcc-display.h: LLCC_DISP/DISP_WB/DISP_1 = vendor use-case ids (ports/qcom-llcc keys tables by firmware ids)
dma_fence_ops value_str hooks removed -> direct sde timeline string in the dump paths (timeline_str now initialised; vendor printed an uninitialised buffer for foreign fences)
dma_fence_array_create without signal_on_any (sde_fence passed 0 = all, the 7.3 behaviour)
drm_atomic_private_obj_init(dev,obj,funcs): MST bridge gets atomic_create_state; error path uses drm_atomic_private_obj_fini (vendor kfree left a freed state on privobj_list)

fb_create gains format info; drm_get_format_info(dev, fmt, modifier); drm_helper_mode_fill_fb_struct(info); irq_domain_create_linear; thermal cdev_id 0; alarm callbacks void + alarm_start_timer; vmf_insert_mixed(pfn); fbdev restore (force=false, fbdev emulation only)
include order: vendor headers before $(srctree)/include/linux (else <soc/qcom/socinfo.h> hits the 7.3 one); vendor clk/rpmh API headers force-included; vendor qcom,icc.h (PWR_ST tags) force-included
pending: display bring-up, DSI panel, DP altmode, HDCP, hw fences, RSC/CESTA on the phone
